winks.rationale: The surname 'Sutter' is itself a California county and town name (past the man to the bare word).
'Marshall' standing alone is a common US town/county name (Marshall, TX; Marshall County, several states).
The bare word 'Golden' is a real US town (Golden, CO), read past the California nickname.
Faint: the term contains no clean standalone US place beyond mining-camp echoes.
The bare word 'Auburn' is a US town in many states (NY, AL, ME), but here it is already literally a CA town.
The word 'Saratoga' is directly Saratoga, NY, the spa town invoked in the Calistoga coinage.
'Columbia' is an extremely common US place name (state capital of SC, plus many towns).
The bare phrase 'Mount Hope' is a US town name (Mount Hope, WV; Mount Hope, KS).
'Nashville' is also a town in North Carolina (and several other states) past the famous TN city.
